    launch(Class<?> type, String[] args)
    Launches an application, in these steps: on the main thread, reads the descriptor of the application class; on macOS, sets apple.awt.application.name to its name and apple.laf.useScreenMenuBar to true; on the main thread, builds the root injector, which binds ApplicationInfo, Arguments, DisplayLocale and the application Scope; on the main thread, runs every StartupStep, sorted by order then by class name; on the EDT, installs the look and feel, checks the icons, creates the main window and shows it; on the EDT, once the events posted while showing the window have run, calls the main view's SingleFrame.ready(), then every ReadyListener.

  • Method Details

    • launch

      public static void launch(Class<?> type, String[] args)
      Launches an application, in these steps:
      1. on the main thread, reads the descriptor of the application class; on macOS, sets apple.awt.application.name to its name and apple.laf.useScreenMenuBar to true;
      2. on the main thread, builds the root injector, which binds ApplicationInfo, Arguments, DisplayLocale and the application Scope;
      3. on the main thread, runs every StartupStep, sorted by order then by class name;
      4. on the EDT, installs the look and feel, checks the icons, creates the main window and shows it;
      5. on the EDT, once the events posted while showing the window have run, calls the main view's SingleFrame.ready(), then every ReadyListener.

      A failure in steps 2 to 4 shows the error dialog if the look and feel is installed, in the application's language once the injector exists and in English before, prints the stack trace otherwise, and exits with status 1 through Exit.

      Parameters:
      type - the application class, annotated with @Application
      args - the arguments
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if no descriptor is registered for the class
